The act of covering eyes isn't neutral—it's a conscious choice to disengage from moral responsibility. 

Practically, it's also counterproductive. Starving animals (or humans) don't disappear because you close your eyes. Ignoring the problem doesn't solve it; it just removes your awareness while the suffering continues.
